title: Registration form
summary: form label tells the user what to fill in, and required reminds the user to fill in the required fields.
tasks: Add label in form, the text is "Name", and the for value is student-name.
Add a text input box and set id="student-name", name="student" and required.
Add a submit button, set type="submit", and the text is "Submit registration".
hint: label must be the same as the id of the input box. name is the field name used when submitting the form.
goal: Add a labeled required text box and submit button to the registration form.

example.code:
<form>
  <label for="book-title">book title</label>
  <input type="text" id="book-title" name="title" required>
  <button type="submit">Add to book list</button>
</form>
example.note: Click the label to focus on the corresponding input box. When you leave it blank and submit, the browser will prompt you to fill in the book title.
